title: RAW UNREVIEWED: terminal incipits select different internal resumptions of one previously written text
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. One historical responsory and its three verses preserve terminal cues that select three different internal positions in the same earlier text. Explore a written instruction/content interface: the same lexical material appears as ordinary content in the base and as a subspan selector in a later construction. This is not a common refrain requirement or a claim that Voynich is liturgical.

design.production_mechanism: The scribe writes one base text, then full intervening units ending in short retrieval cues instead of rewriting each resumed passage. The cues select different internal starts, so the written entries are interdependent. A complete reading needs both the intervening content and the retrieval instructions; expanding every repeated item from the start of the base changes the content produced.

actual_source.witness: Paris BnF Latin1085, St Martial de Limoges, Cantus dating975-1000; f003v sequence8 and f004r sequences1-3.
actual_source.source_fields_read: Complete Full text as in Source fields, both standardized and source spelling, for all four entries; surrounding record metadata. No native image collation claimed.
actual_source.bounded_observation: The full Aspiciens respond contains three successive internal starts. The following complete verse entries end, in their source-spelling fields, with Ite obviam, Ostende and Qui regnas respectively. Each matches a different internal start in that respond. The standardized fields omit these terminal cues. Their vertical separators are database encoding, not newly verified manuscript punctuation.
actual_source.interpretation_limit: Entry genre and ordering support a repetendum-cue interpretation. Exact sung stopping points, a doxology and universal resumption to the end are not established by these four transcribed entries alone. Do not silently add them.

finite_rivals.INTERNAL_START_SELECTOR: A terminal cue identifies its matching interior start in the common base; the three starts differ. Continuation endpoint remains an explicit parameter until source performance rules fix it.
finite_rivals.WHOLE_BASE_RESTART: Every cue invokes the base from its beginning; this loses the three different written starts.
finite_rivals.LITERAL_TERMINAL_CONTENT: The terminal expressions are only appended content and cause no retrieval of an earlier subspan.
finite_rivals.EXTERNAL_TITLE_REFERENCE: Each cue names an independently supplied outside text. This adds three external owners instead of resolving the cues within the already written base. Such owners cannot be invented merely to rescue a fit.

design.observable_grammar_coupling: The shared grammar must make a cue's complete written identity agree with the selected start in its own base while also explaining its different construction role at the later unit boundary. Base edits that remove or duplicate a cue start alter reference resolution without changing the later cue. A free per-occurrence semantic label cannot satisfy this identity dependency. A successful unknown-key account may jointly infer lexicon, cue role and base segmentation; no preconfirmed word is logically required.
design.use_of_existing_structure: Use hierarchy at spaces and directed composition plus whole-form/context residuals (GDT608/282/286/318), not a characterwise Latin code. Complete forms and exact reader channels remain separate. Any alternative realization of content versus cue position needs one shared finite rule, with all corresponding occurrences accounted for; p/y1073 is positional evidence only and cannot be named RETURN. Known r/l transfer915 does not license new stem-pair grammar contradicted in916.
design.whole_reading_falsifier: Reject a nominated whole-entry account if its fixed cue construction selects no written start, selects several while claiming uniqueness, changes base ownership to fit each occurrence, or needs an unrecorded extra phrase to recover the chosen continuation. An ambiguous start remains ambiguous. A simple recurrence count or a shorter-versus-longer pair is not the proposed test.
design.smallest_next_step: Retain as an alternative source-supported writing architecture for the whole-reading author. Before any target scoring, give one finite jointly inferred candidate account over complete already admitted units and list all terminal-to-internal equations it requires. Compare the same lexical assignments under internal-start, whole-restart and literal-content readings. Keep all unparsed material. Do not undertake a new large corpus/decoder merely because the historical mechanism exists.
predecessors: IDEA393, research_registry/proposals/raw_benedict_psalter_reference_partition.json, already owns whole/part allocation and coverage. The added mechanism here is the same explicitly written short sequence functioning as internal content and later retrieval cue, with three different in-document starts; no weekly/number invariant is proposed.

IDEA871, research_registry/proposals/laufenberg_f85r2_20260926/source_supply_20260929/GD_RAW_F83_LITERAL_LYRIC_INSTRUCTION_COUPLING_20261002.json, fixes an injective source-letter code for whole Harley978 lyrics plus instructions and requires external note/word underlay. This card instead concerns directly transcribed in-document lexical subspan cues, with no source-copy, music-event code or underlay premise. GDT970/1022/911 stops named in871 remain unchanged; the present source cannot supply Voynich musical ownership.

GDT954, experiments/yolo/gdt954_shared_invocation_refrain/REPORT.md, refuted identical terminal one-/five-group refrains across seven records. Its result stands. This proposal predicts different terminal cues owned by different internal starts, not a relaxed constant refrain, and provides no automatic target rerun.
GDT914/925/928 fixed literal-parallel failures remain closed. No arbitrary edit distance, normalization or selected near-match counts as a retrieval cue.
IDEA895 process-pattern reuse and IDEA900 physical inscription-carrier lifetime are not the present claim: this mechanism selects a written subspan and changes generated textual continuation.
GDT798's text-back-reference versus remedy ambiguity supplies no confirmed antecedent or reference lexeme here.
design.frequency_and_selection_limits: A frequent cue-like whole form must have its full exact-form frequency, dispersion, grammatical positions, repeated contexts and counterexamples retrieved before any concrete meaning is proposed. None is selected in this card. Section-wide high frequency cannot be explained by a rare liturgical expression without independent evidence. Domain names and source identity remain permutable even if a reference operation is recovered. No significance or independent confirmation asserted.
design.access: Only current route, relevant existing reports/proposals and external institutional source transcriptions read. No target packet/image, new admission, reserve or experiment; f84/f84r remain sealed. Raw supply only.
